option_relations.rationale: The patient's symptoms and ophthalmoscopic examination results are consistent with Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO), which is directly matched with the leaf ID FLAT.1
Macular retinal vein occlusion with chronic cystoid macular edema can be considered a subtype of Central Retinal Vein Occlusion, as it involves a specific complication of CRVO
Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO) is a different condition from Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO), and there is no direct relation between the option and the leaf ID FLAT.1
Retinal vein occlusion is a broader term that encompasses Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO), making it a supertype of the leaf ID FLAT.1
